subject: general
question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 10 days, 15 days and 20 days respectively. If they work together, then the work will be completed in:
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete a work = 10 days

Time taken by B to complete a work = 15 days

Time taken by C to complete a work = 20 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 10, 15 and 20 is 60
